description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseAttribute' within the OpenMRS project. The class provides common properties and methods for attribute objects, including owner management, attribute type, value handling, change tracking, and comparison logic. It serves as a base for concrete attribute implementations, encapsulating behavior and data related to customizable attributes with persistence and search integrations.

classes.name: BaseAttribute
classes.description: An abstract base class for attribute entities with generic attribute type and owner, supporting persistence, search indexing, and comparison.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Returns the owner of this attribute.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner of this attribute.

methods.name: setAttributeType
methods.description: Assigns an attribute type to this attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute type of this attribute.

methods.name: getDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the attribute type as its descriptor.

methods.name: getValueReference
methods.description: Gets the reference string representing the attribute's value; throws if not persisted.

methods.name: setValueReferenceInternal
methods.description: Sets the internal value reference string, marking the attribute as clean.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the attribute's value, converting from reference string.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the attribute's value as a typed object, marking it as dirty.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Returns whether the attribute has unsaved changes.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Defines comparison logic for attributes based on voided status, attribute type, value reference, and ID.
